description:
Kind: tool

Problem
This capability was never missing, it was MULTIPLIED. Measured 2026-08-20: 312 modules match workflow/playbook/pipeline/orchestrat and ELEVEN classes are engine-shaped, four of them full rivals that do not reference each other and carry separate consumer sets -- ExpeditionManager (43 files), WorkflowEngine (12), AgentWorkflow (4), PlaybookEngine (3). Two are files with the SAME NAME in different trees. Nothing was broken, and nobody could say which one runs a flow.

Install
pip install awflow
